info.name: CATAAS List Cats in the Catalog

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags to filter on. Returns only cats that carry at least one of the given tags.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

items.docs: Returns an array of cat documents. Filter by tags and paginate using `skip` and `limit`. Use this endpoint to discover ids consumable by `/cat/{id}`.
Returns a sorted array of every unique tag attached to a cat in the catalog.

info.name: CATAAS Get the Total Number of Cats

items.docs: Returns a single document with the total count of cats in the catalog.
